simple.meaning: to be heavy , i.e. in a bad sense ( burdensome , severe , dull ) or in a good sense ( numerous , rich , honorable ); causatively, to make weighty (in the same two senses)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כָּבַד (H3513) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 116 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.

definitions.full: H3513. kabad or kabed כָּבֵד verb be heavy, weighty, burdensome, honoured (Late Hebrew Pi`el honour , and derivatives, כֹּבֶד weight ; Phoenician proper name, feminine כבדת = honoured one , and in compound proper name; Ethiopic be heavy , etc.; Assyrian kabâdu or kabâtu , grow or be heavy , Dl HWB ; compare Arabic difficulty, distress ; III. struggle with difficulties , etc.; Zinjirli כבדו honour , DHM Sendsch. 58 ; Sabean כבודת gifts of honour , = Hebrew נדבה freewill offering DHM ZMG 1883, 341 f. — Qal Perfect ׳כ Isa 24:20 ; 3 feminine singular כָּֽבְדָה Gen 18:20 4 t.; כָּבֵ֑דָה Judg 20:34 ; 3 masculine plural כָּֽבְדוּ Gen 48:10 ; Imperfect יִכְבַּד Exod 9:7 ; Isa 66:5 ; יִכְבָּ֑ד Job 6:3 ; 33:7 10 t. Imperfect ( כָּבֵד Gen 12:10 + is given as 3 masculine Perfect by some; but it is probably taken better as adjective SS make כָּבֵד Psa 38:5 infinitive absolute; < Thes adjective ). — 1 be heavy , in weight, of misfortune, heavier than sand Job 6:3 ; of God's hand in punishment 1Sam 5:11 , with אֶל 5:6 ; עַל Psa 32:4 ; of man's hand in war Judg 1:35 ; עַלאַֿנְחָתִי כָּֽבְדָה יָדִי my hand is heavy upon my groaning Job 23:2 is explained by ᵑ7 Hrz Schlottm as hand smiting me ; but read rather with ᵑ6 ᵐ5 Ew De Reu Di יָדוֺ of God's hand; of pressure אַכְמִּי 33:7 ( כַּמִּי ᵐ5 ); = vehement, sore , of battle Judg 20:34 ; with אֶל 1Sam 31:3 = עַל 1Chr 10:3 ; burdensome, grievous ; עָלֶי֑ךָ נִכְבַּד וְלֹא lest we be burdensome unto thee 2Sam 13:23 ; of work laid upon one, bondage, with עַל Exod 5:9 (JE) Neh 5:18 ; of sin conceived as a burden Gen 18:20 (J), iniquities Psa 38:5 ; transgressions, with עַל Isa 24:20 . 2 heavy, insensible, dull ,of the eyes, so as to be unable to see Gen 48:10 (JE); of the ears Isa 59:1 ; of the לֵב , hard, insensible Exod 9:7 (J; P and E's synonym is חָזַק , q. v.) 3 be honoured (compare βαρύς ) of a man Job 14:21 (opposed to יצערו : compare Hiph`il 3 ), of Tyre Ezek 27:25 , of Yahweh Isa 66:5 .
